U2-NetP saliency model notice

The upstream xuebinqin/U-2-Net repository declares Apache License 2.0. The
bundled ONNX file is downloaded from the rembg v0.0.0 release asset and is
locked by size and SHA-256 in cmake/smart-crop-models.json. The exact export
and release-asset provenance has not been independently confirmed. The project
maintainer has approved distribution of this pinned file for the Windows x64
CUDA smart-crop package with that limitation recorded in the release evidence.

Upstream references:
- https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net/blob/master/LICENSE
- https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/tag/v0.0.0
- https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/issues/837
